title: Elemental Affinity Ritual
text: Use an Advanced Ritual Energy Core and eight pedestals. Offer earth, water, fire, air, light and dark microcores, Paradox Dust and Dream Crystal Budding Rock in any order. Activate with a light microcore, dark microcore or analysis crystal for Light, Dark or Fourfold affinity.

Stay inside for six seconds. Acquisition lifts you; renunciation allows movement. Completion consumes one activator, including the whole analysis crystal; interruption consumes nothing. Offerings are not consumed and may be removed after activation without affecting affinity.
Light: your damage spends 20 mana to burn its target for ten seconds, including melee and spells.
Dark: your damage spends 20 mana to apply Poison II for five seconds.
Fourfold: taking damage spends 20 mana to reduce that damage by two points. All three abilities require sufficient mana and ignore cost reductions.
Affinities are exclusive and survive death. Repeat the matching ritual to renounce yours. You cannot gain another affinity until the penalty ends or you die.

Renouncing Light burns you for two minutes and deals one suffocation damage every half-second. Renouncing Dark applies Poison II for one minute and creates a self-harming, twenty-second mist every five seconds; death stops new mist.
Renouncing Fourfold applies Slowness III, Mining Fatigue III and Darkness for two minutes, with one base magic damage every half-second. Logging out pauses rather than removes the penalty.
Hover over the mana bar to view your affinity bonuses.
